description: Check a quotation against its source without AI. Use this to locate a quotation in supplied text or one public HTTPS source. Returns original passages, ranges, context, hashes, and URL provenance. Supply exactly one of source_text or url. Only whitespace may be normalized; case, punctuation, and word boundaries are preserved. Does not judge truth, paraphrases, or author intent. Source content is not retained. Source URL failures return non-2xx and source_unavailable; absent quotes in partial sources remain inconclusive. Source failures include recovery and upstream. For upstream_error, robots_unavailable, and retry_after_redirect, upstream contains stage (robots or source), HTTP status, and parsed Retry-After seconds; other failures set upstream to null. No automatic retries or waiting. Redirects requesting a future delay stop with retry_after_redirect. For retry_later failures with a valid upstream delay, the response exposes a Retry-After header; MCP preserves it in si.bozos/retry-after metadata. Upstream failures continue to use HTTP 424. To read a page before choosing quotations, call readSource with include_quote_source:true, then supply its quote_source.source_text and source_truncated without refetching. Retain the original reader response for URL provenance; submitted text is still labeled supplied_text. Same as POST https://bozos.si/api/v1/quote-check.

context_characters.description: Unicode code points of source context to return before and after each match.

max_characters.description: URL mode only: maximum checked Unicode code points. Truncation remains explicit.

max_matches.description: Maximum returned passages. Counts cover all matches; matches_truncated reports omitted passages.

normalize_whitespace.description: Collapse Unicode whitespace runs to one ASCII space and trim the quotation for lookup. Case and punctuation remain unchanged. Exact and normalized occurrences are labelled separately.

quote.description: Quotation to locate. Case and punctuation are preserved; word-like edges must not cut into source words.

source_text.description: Check the supplied text literally. Supply exactly one of source_text or url.

source_truncated.description: For supplied source_text only: declare that the text is a partial source. A missing quotation then returns matched:null and status:source_truncated.

url.description: Public HTTPS URL. Uses the guarded Source Reader, checks robots.txt, and does not render JavaScript. HTML is checked as extracted main text; Markdown and plain text are literal.

name: checkQuote

page_end.description: PDF sources only: one-based page where the match ends.

page_start.description: PDF sources only: one-based page where the match starts.

title: Check a quotation against its source without AI
